items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... This is a hot place. Southern... Yes. Mary Gordon. No. No. No. No. It's Jackson Avenue.

ctx.x: They used to play on the roof guard. George used to play.

Not only that. He played at... This is where his gold watch was stolen. They're always stealing from him. Is it Tin Roof? Not Tin Roof. No, no. This place was right off of Jackson Avenue. On this fellow who died in the crazy house. He's a piano player. I know just where you're making. Steve... Steve Lewis. Steve Lewis was his piano player. Yes, Steve Lewis. Steve Lewis. And they played at this. This was some name. What can I think of this? This is a hot place. Southern... Yes. Mary Gordon. No. No. No. No. It's…
That's right. I'm afraid. No living there.
